stem: Why can the same pollen-producing structure lead to different management responses in a breeding room and an unseeded-flower production room?
choices: Crop objective, authorization, containment, genetic identity, and SOP determine whether the structure is intentional or a deviation requiring escalation
The biological structure changes its identity based on the room name
Breeding rooms do not require records
Unseeded-flower rooms can ignore reproductive morphology
rationale: The observed structure may be biologically similar, but operational significance depends on crop objective and authorized procedure. Records and containment remain important in both settings.
